exact_field_replacements.value: Unresolved failed activation, rollback or relaunch, and actual retained recovery artifacts have been independently verified and recorded. Do not show the kept-files claim when no artifacts exist or their retention cannot be verified. In that case use RECOVERY_STATUS_UNKNOWN, without claiming restored, retained files or installation ready.

A verified previous-application baseline exists and its concrete restore operation has actually begun and is in progress. Not a fresh install with no previous application, not a merely planned restore, and not a recovery-success claim.
